QuestInfo.name: Among Dragons
QuestInfo.1:
Feng thinks the Devil Clan is collecting ingredients needed to make some legendary elixir. He suspects they were headed here to Minar Forest. 
He turned out to be right! 
Defeat the clan members and stop their plans!
QuestInfo.2:
Feng thinks the Devil Clan is collecting ingredients needed to make some legendary elixir. He suspected they were headed here to Minar Forest. 
Feng turned out to be right! 
The henchmen of the Devil Clan were soon spotted looking for Lingshen Fire Grass, the last ingredient for the elixir. Yun Wu wasn't there, but you successfully stopped them from gathering what they needed.

Feng said that #esomeone must have been gravely injured in the previous fight if they need the elixir, and that you had to move fast#k before they recover.

default.0: The henchmen of the Devil Clan need to be taken down so they can't get ingredients for the elixir!\r\n
